subject: Data Engineering
title: Automated Data Testing
description: A quick, practical guide to Automated Data Testing.

hook.text: A pipeline passes but the output table has zero rows. Nobody notices for three days.

buildup.text: Automated tests check expectations: row counts above zero, no nulls in key columns, valid ranges.

discovery.text: Tools like Great Expectations and dbt tests define quality rules as code, checked every run.

twist.text: Tests don't guarantee perfect data. They guarantee you'll know when expected conditions are violated.

climax.text: A pipeline without data tests is like code without unit tests — it works until it silently doesn't.

punchline.text: Test the data, not just the code.

quiz.question: What do automated data tests verify?
options: That data meets expected conditions like row counts and valid ranges
